rules.name: critical-risk-requires-approval
rules.description: CRITICAL risk nodes always require human approval before execution.

rules.name: high-risk-requires-approval
rules.description: HIGH risk nodes require human approval before execution, unless the run is in --auto-approve mode.

rules.name: change-budget
rules.description: Denies a brownfield node's completion when its real diff touches more than maxFilesChanged files or adds more than maxLinesAdded lines.

rules.name: protected-paths-global
rules.description: Denies any reported write whose canonically resolved path falls outside target-service/ or runs/, including via ../ traversal or an absolute path elsewhere on disk.

rules.name: write-paths-contract
rules.description: Denies any reported write that falls outside the node's own declared writePaths, enforcing the same contract the checkpoint mechanism relies on.

rules.name: no-secrets-in-diff
rules.description: Denies completion when a written file's content matches a credential-shaped pattern (API keys, AWS access keys, private key blocks, bearer tokens).

rules.name: no-dependency-additions
rules.description: Requires human approval when a diff modifies a dependency manifest (pom.xml, build.gradle, build.gradle.kts).

rules.name: evidence-before-release
rules.description: Denies the RELEASE node's admission when any acceptance criterion lacks passing evidence.
